variant_policy.pre_refine_meaning: Newly source-improved immutable built output immediately before final microrefine; never the legacy cache.
variant_policy.post_refine_meaning: Separate microrefined output with independent provenance and validation.
variant_policy.preferred_variant_persistence: Application controller owns per-model preference; adapter never changes it.

native_contract.configure: configure(micro_model, document, verified_part_names, variant_id=selected_variant, content_identity=verified_cache_sha256) before ProceduralModel
native_contract.selectors: Exact native Part.name == viewer Item.key; alias changes only Item.name transiently.
native_contract.source_color_and_normal_policy: No native mesh/material/vertex-color/normal mutation or global viewing-setting changes.
native_contract.geometry_state_policy: Clear transient explode/reveal offsets, restore them on exit; never stretch passages.

limitations: No arrays, builder imports, heavy geometry, rendering or native app launch performed.
All camera/plane positions are authored source anchors and need separate-machine native visual review on each variant.
The adapter does not implement physiological deformation, ion transport, pigment transfer or sensation simulation.
No new preview was made; source readiness is not anatomical or visual acceptance.
